name: Infer: Xinference (vLLM engine)
short_desc: Xorbits Inference model platform (web UI, model registry) driving vLLM
author: Morteza Rastgoo
description: Xinference v4.2.0 slim image: a supervisor + worker with a web UI on the API port, an OpenAI and Anthropic API, and a model registry. The image ships no engine: on the first launch Xinference pip-installs vLLM into a per-model virtualenv under /data/xinference (needs internet, several GB, several minutes). The `qwen3.8` family pins vllm==0.21.0, which never finished loading the 27B here (2026-11-25), so XINF_VLLM (default vllm==0.33.0, as in infer-vllm) overrides it. The app starts the server, then launches MODEL as uid SERVED_NAME. Prefix caching and fp8 KV are passed as vLLM kwargs. SPEC_TOKENS, KV_CPU_GB and CHAT_TEMPLATE are ignored (Xinference uses the family template). Worker metrics: port 9998 inside the container.

form_fields.label: Models directory (host)
form_fields.hint: Host folder with your model weights. It is mounted read-only at the same path.

form_fields.label: Model path
form_fields.hint: Absolute path inside the models directory, for example /opt/models/<model>.

form_fields.label: Served model name
form_fields.hint: Name clients send in the `model` field.

form_fields.label: GPU memory fraction
form_fields.hint: Fraction of total VRAM for weights + KV. Smoke test: 0.10.

form_fields.label: Speculative tokens (MTP)
form_fields.hint: Native MTP draft tokens. 0 disables. The DSpine DFlash draft is not portable.

form_fields.label: MPS VRAM cap
form_fields.hint: CUDA_MPS_PINNED_DEVICE_MEM_LIMIT. Smoke test with host vLLM running: 0=12G.

form_fields.label: Chat template
form_fields.hint: Jinja file, or `none` for the model's own template (use `none` for the smoke model).

form_fields.label: Extra engine args
form_fields.hint: Appended verbatim to the engine command.

form_fields.label: Xinference model family
form_fields.hint: Built-in family name (qwen3.8 for the 27B, Qwen3-Instruct for the 4B smoke model).

form_fields.label: Model size (billions)
form_fields.hint: Size of the family spec, e.g. 27 or 4.

form_fields.label: vLLM package
form_fields.hint: Overrides the family's vLLM pin in the model virtualenv; 'none' keeps the pin.
